name: intraday_poc-train
notes: The PRODUCTION fit: one LSTM per symbol over every published bar, artifacts the live loop restores. Run from the child root after the backfill is published: python -m dskit.pipeline run configs/run-train.json --asof 2026-08-25 --adapter intraday_poc. Then point the forward loop at the run dir: python -m intraday_poc.live --run-dir <run dir>. The node keys qhat_aapl / qhat_msft are a CONTRACT with live.py's DEFAULT_ARTIFACTS table — rename both sides together or pass --artifact overrides.

bars.notes: Role data: the onboarding store's deduplicated bar records, bitemporally resolved (latest acquired_at wins per (symbol, ts)). root is relative to the invoking cwd — run from the child root.

window.notes: 30 one-minute log returns per row, next-bar return as label. max_gap_minutes 5 tolerates thin IEX minutes without ever bridging a session boundary; windows crossing a larger gap are dropped, not interpolated.

aapl_rows.notes: One model per symbol — the PoC's design, so each series is fit on its own dynamics.

qhat_aapl.notes: ADR-0025 declared seam: the document names the child's nn.Module and the optimizer; the module owns the flat-lag-vector -> LSTM-sequence resequencing, so the pack's default RowVectorAdapter carries it. features MUST stay ret_lag_0..ret_lag_{lookback-1} in order and module_params.lookback must equal the window node's lookback — the module refuses a width mismatch at run. device is declared explicitly (not left to sniff whatever the box has) so a GPU box's run stays reproducible on CPU until a GPU device string is deliberately swapped in. optimizer_params names Adam's other knobs (weight_decay etc.) explicitly at their library defaults, so the knob is visible and adjustable rather than a silent zero. No monitor is set here: this document wires no val_rows (it trains on every published bar), and ADR-0035's monitor selects on validation telemetry — the run refuses a monitor with no val_rows wired, so declaring one would only break the production fit.

qhat_msft.notes: The MSFT twin of qhat_aapl — same architecture, its own weights. device/optimizer_params mirror qhat_aapl's rationale: an explicit CPU knob for this GPU box and Adam's other kwargs named at their library defaults. No monitor here either, for the same reason: no val_rows wired on this document.
